title: Model Switch Savings Sheet
one_liner: Paste your monthly token usage per workload and see the cost on each candidate model, plus where prices are heading.
headline: Enter your LLM workloads and a price table (pre-filled with the episode's Kimi pricing) to see the cheapest model that clears your quality bar today, your savings, and a 12-month cost projection.

episode.title: Anthropic’s $2T IPO, Elon Predicts Neocloud Death, and China’s Kimi Catches Up | #306

history.summary: A genuinely useful, well-built cost calculator: the math checks out exactly (verified $400 vs $2,700 monthly, $27,600/yr savings, and the halving-decay chart values all reconcile), episode figures and illustrative/example data are clearly and consistently labeled, and the mobile/accessibility handling (stacked tables, 40px targets, aria-labels, focus rings) is solid. Code is clean, self-contained, and has no dead code or unpinned dependencies. This is close to a model prototype for the "tool" kind — a founder could plausibly reuse it quarterly as the opportunity brief describes.
